title: 雄猫道具与商店线（道具说明）（第 2／4 部分）

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HEY, TOMCAT. I JUST PICKED UP SOME SORT OF WEIRD...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，雄猫。我刚捡到个奇怪的……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...CARD THING?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……卡片之类的？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOT JUST ANY CARD, THAT'S A COSMOCARD, PUP!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [可不是普通卡，那是宇宙卡，小狗！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT WON'T HELP YOU OPEN ANY DOORS OR ANYTHING LIKE THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它不能帮你开门之类的，但它/确实/能让你多了解些当地动物！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT IT /WILL/ GIVE YOU SOME MORE INFO ON LOCAL FAUNA!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HOW? THERE'S ONLY PICTURES ON IT!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [怎么看？上面只有图啊！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SEE THOSE LITTLE DOTS ON THE SIDE? SLIDE THAT INTO THE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看到侧面那些小点了吗？把它插进P.A.W.的C读卡器里，就能查看更多资料。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [C-READER ON YOUR P.A.W. AND IT'LL GIVE YOU MORE INFO]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OOOOH I SEE! I CAN ACCESS THE DATA IN A P.A.W. SUB MENU!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哦哦，懂了！P.A.W.子菜单里就能查数据！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE THERE'S DATA ON ENEMEY POWER AND ITEM DROPS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [看来有敌人强度和物品掉落的资料，而卡片背面是……是……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [AND ON THE CARD BACKS IT'S... IT'S...]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEHE...!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿嘿……！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [TAKE YOUR TIME READING THE BACK OF THE CARDS, PUP]
rows.current: Tomcat: [慢慢看卡片背面吧，小狗]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE ALL NEED A LITTLE BREAK NOW AND AGAIN!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [谁都需要偶尔放松一下嘛！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [R-RIGHT...///]
rows.current: Yiffai: [也、也是……///]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [FINALLY GOT YOUR HELMET BACK! AFTER ALL THIS TIME!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [终于把头盔拿回来了！过了这么久！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I KNOW, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [可不是嘛？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [COMPLETE THAT WITH THE COSMO SUIT PORTION]
rows.current: Tomcat: [再配上宇宙服那一部分，你就有一套漂亮的气密制服了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND YOU'LL HAVE A NICE AIRTIGHT UNIFORM COMPLETE!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'LL LET YOU BREATHE IN ANY SORT OF ATMOSPHERE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那样你就能在任何大气里呼吸了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AWWW, IS THAT A LEASH THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP THERE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哎哟，你刚捡到的是条牵引绳吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I DIDN'T KNOW YOU STILL NEEDED ONE OF THOSE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我不知道你还需要这个！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [H-HEY!! I REALLY REALLY DON'T!! IT'S JUST...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [喂、喂！！我真的真的不需要！！只是……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...IT'S JUST A COMFORT THING, THAT'S ALL!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……只是用着舒服，就这样！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT SHOULD AT LEAST PROVIDE YOU WITH A BIT OF PROTECTION]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只要装备上，它至少能给你提供一点防护。在P.A.W.菜单里操作！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IF YOU EQUIP IT. YOU CAN DO SO FROM YOUR P.A.W. MENU!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [O-OF COURSE, I KNOW THAT...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [当、当然，我知道……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AN ELFIN TIARA? KINDA SURPRISED YOU WENT FOR THAT.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [精灵头冠？还挺意外你会选这个。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [EH, WHY NOT? IT'S REGAL *AND* EXTRA-DEFENSIVE!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [呃，为什么不呢？又威风*又*额外能防！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEY, I'M NOT COMPLAINING. IT LOOKS CUTE ON YOU.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿，我可没抱怨。戴在你头上挺可爱。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH YEAH, THAT TOO...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是是，那个也是……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OKAY I KNOW THAT THE SELLER TOLD YOU THAT IT WAS MEAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [好吧，我知道卖家跟你说那是肉，可我在那包里没检测到任何蛋白质……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT I'M NOT DETECT- ING ANYTHING PROTEIN IN THAT PACKAGE...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I'M SURE I'LL BE FIIIIINE.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我肯定没————事。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IT'S NOT THE WORST LOOKING MEAT I'VE PUT IN MY MOUTH.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这不是我塞进嘴里最难看的肉。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [UGH, REALLY GONNA EAT THAT? I MEAN, IT WON'T KILL YOU.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呃，真要吃那个？我是说，它不会要了你的命。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PROBABLY.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [大概。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WHERE'S YOUR SPIRIT OF ADVENTURE? IT COULD'T BE WORSE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你的冒险精神呢？总不会比我小时候还是幼犬时吞嚼咬玩具更糟。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THAN WHEN I USED TO SWALLOW CHEW TOYS AS A PUP.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ALRIGHT I'M JUST GONNA PETITION FOR YOU TO REQUIRE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [行，我这就申请，要求你把任何东西放进嘴里之前先得到批准。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [APPROVAL BEFORE YOU PUT ANYTHING IN YOUR MOUTH.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SOUNDS FUN! I CAN GET A LIVE VIDEO FEED GOING FOR YOU]
rows.current: Yiffany: [听着挺有意思！我可以给你开一路直播，你就能逐个批准那些男孩，等我把他们单独带去——]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [AND YOU CAN APPROVE EACH BOY AS I GET THEM ALONE TO-]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOOO THANKS, SAVE THAT FOR BOSSU.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不——用了，谢谢，留给波苏吧。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.current: Bossu: [……]

rows.source: [OKAY I KNOW THAT THE SELLER TOLD YOU THAT IT WAS MEAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [好吧，我知道卖家跟你说那是肉，可我在那包里没检测到任何蛋白质……]

rows.source: [BUT I'M NOT DETECT- ING ANYTHING PROTEIN IN THAT PACKAGE...]
[IT SMELLS KIND OF LIKE...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [闻起来有点像……]

rows.source: [...GASOLINE?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……汽油？]

rows.source: [BLECH! WELL, ENJOY THAT. I'M GONNA GO THROW UP NOW.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呕！好吧，你享用那个吧。我现在要去吐了。]

rows.source: [THAAAAAANKS...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [谢啊啊啊啊啊啊……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PSH, IS THAT AN ICE SODA YOU'VE GOT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [切，你拿的是冰汽水吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [EH, THE SHOPKEEPER WAS ENTHUSIASTIC ABOUT IT, AND]
rows.current: Yiffany: [呃，店主对它可热情了，而且我觉得能帮我对付矿井里的热。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I FIGURED IT WOULD HELP BEAT THE HEAT IN THE MINES]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HELP WITH YOUR HEAT? BUT I DETECT NO ESTRUS BLOCKERS-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [帮你退热？可我没检测到发情阻断剂-]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THE TEMPERATURE, TOMCAT.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是温度，雄猫。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH RIGHT, S-SILLY ME! *THAT* HEAT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦对，是、是我傻了！*那种*热！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OKAY STOP ROLLING YOUR EYES AT ME! BYE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [好了别对着我翻白眼！再见！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NOW THIS BRINGS BACK MEMORIES.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这可勾起回忆了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [LOOKATHAT. AN OLD JUDO GI!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [瞧这个。一件旧柔道服！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IT ALWAYS MADE ME FEEL LIKE A BADASS WHEN I WORE MINE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我穿着自己那件在学院里随便走时，总觉得自己很猛。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [JUST CASUALLY AROUND THE ACADEMY.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [MAYBE THAT'S WHY YOU KEPT GET'N INTO FIGHTS ALL THE TIME]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也许这就是你老是打起来的原因]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [JUST DON'T FORGET THAT YOU HAVE A LIGHTTAZER ON YOU]
rows.current: Tomcat: [别忘了你身上有光电击枪]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NO REASON TO DRESS UP AND GO BAREHANDED DOWN THERE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没必要穿成这样赤手下场。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [EVEN IF IT MAKES YOU FEEL LIKE A BADASS AGAIN!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [就算它又让你觉得自己很猛！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TOMCAT, COME IN.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [雄猫，收到请回答。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TELL ME THEY WEREN'T SERIOUS WHEN THEY SAID THAT I C-]
rows.current: Yiffany: [快告诉我，他们不是认真的！居然说我不——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [-CAN'T DISCARD A KEY UNDER ANY CIRCU- MSTANCES AT ALL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [——不管什么情况都不能丢掉钥匙。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU READ THE REPORT, YOU KNOW WHY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [报告你看过，你知道为什么！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I'M PRETTY SURE I COULD JUST BREAK INTO MOST LOCKS]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我很确定，真有需要的话，大多数锁我都能撬开。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IF I REALLY NEEDED TO.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WELL, WHAT DOES IT MATTER ANYWAYS? JUST PUT THOSE KEYS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那又有什么关系？把那些钥匙放进你的夹克口袋里。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [INTO YOUR JACKET POCKETS.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.current: Yiffany: [……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THESE POCKETS ARE JUST FOR SHOW...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这些口袋只是摆设……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH...WELL GOOD LUCK THEN!!!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦……那祝你好运！！！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT SEEMS TO BE THE BODY PORTION OF SOME SORT OF...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这好像是某种……服装的衣身部分]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...SCALE SUIT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……鳞皮套装？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SEEMS KINDA WEIRD. CAN YOU FILL ME IN ON IT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [感觉怪怪的。给我讲讲呗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WELLLL SOME FOLKS I KNEW BACK AT THE ACADEMY WERE REALLY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这个嘛，我在学院认识的一些家伙特别热衷于扮成别的种族……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [INTO DRESSING UP AS OTHER SPECIES...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WASN'T REALLY MY THING, BUT I USED TO TAKE PART NOW AND]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我不算特别喜欢，但以前偶尔也会玩玩，主要是他们还有些很棒的玩具可以配着——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AGAIN, MOSTLY 'CUS THEY HAD GREAT TOYS TO GO ALONG WI-]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [THAT IS  N O T  WHAT THIS OUTFIT IS FOR!!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这套衣服绝、对、不、是干那个用的！！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [...RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……对吧？]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [YOU'LL HAVE TO FIND SOMEONE LESS PURR- VERTED THAN TOMCAT]
rows.current: Mauser: [伊吠，想弄清这套衣服的用途，你得找个没雄猫那么色的家伙来问！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [TO TELL YOU WHAT THAT SUIT IS FOR, YIFFAI!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HMMMPH!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哼嗯！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [LOOK I'M NOT EVEN GONNA COMMENT ON THIS STUFF ANYMORE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [听着，这种东西我再也不评论了]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [JUST... MAKE SURE YOU GET A FULL SET OF KOBO GEAR]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只是……务必凑齐一整套科博德装备，也就是爪子、头部和身体……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHICH MEANS THE CLAWS, HEAD, AND BODY...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...OR I'M GONNA HAVE TO JUDGE YA FOR WEARING A PARTIAL]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……不然我可要笑话你只穿半套]

rows.source: [LOOK I'M NOT ONE TO COMMENT ON THIS SORTA STUFF, BUT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [听着，我一般不评论这种东西，不过……]

rows.source: [JUST... MAKE SURE YOU GET A FULL SET OF KOBO GEAR]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只是……务必凑齐一整套科博德装备，就是爪子、头部和身体……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GEEZE THIS IS HEAVY!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哇，这东西好重！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THOSE DWARVES ARE NO SLOUCHES. THEY WIELD THEIR PICKAX]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那些矮人可不含糊，挥起矿镐来就是一整天，仿佛用不完似的。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ALL DAY WITH A SEEMINGLY ENDLESS SUPPLY.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WITH ARMS LIKE YOURS, YOU'RE ONLY GONNA GET A SINGLE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [就你这胳膊，一把镐只能扔一次，所以要扔得值！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THROW OUT OF A PICKAX SO MAKE IT COUNT!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [JUST GOTTA MAKE SURE I THROW IT REAL HARD, REAL HIGH...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [只要扔得够用力、够高就行……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [JEEZ THIS IS HEAVY!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [天哪，这可真重！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THOSE DWARVES ARE NO SLOUCHES. THEY WIELD THEIR PICKAX]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那些矮人可不含糊，整天挥起矿镐来，仿佛有用不完的力气。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WITH ARMS LIKE YOURS, YOU'RE ONLY GONNA GET A SINGLE]
